intro: Boulder's public sauna scene is made up of small independent bathhouses and sauna clubs, most of them clustered in the North Boulder Arts District along Broadway, plus a converted warehouse bathhouse in east Boulder and a garden sauna club near downtown on Pearl Street. Ever Sky, Third Space and Berner Collective all sell single drop-in visits around $30-35, while PORTAL runs bookable sessions on a credit system. Prices, hours and session formats change, so confirm with each venue before you go.

venues.name: Ever Sky
venues.drop_in_price: $30 drop-in ($20 first visit; $40 friend drop-in for two)
venues.session_length: No time limit (book a time slot for capacity)
venues.schedule: Mixed sessions, 18+. Women-only bathhouse session every Wednesday at 12pm. Daily hours are Unknown on the venue's own site (a sauna listing site shows noon-9pm daily). Drop-ins welcome; booking online first is encouraged.
venues.notes: Small bathhouse with one large Finnish-style sauna at 160-180°F, a record listening lounge with complimentary hot drinks, changing rooms, lockers and showers. Swimsuit or athletic wear required; towels available if needed. Heat source not stated. Free parking in the lot behind Yoga Pearl. 8-visit pack $180; unlimited membership $155/month.

venues.name: PORTAL° Boulder
venues.neighborhood: North Boulder (Emerald City, NoBo Arts District)
venues.session_length: Unknown (fixed booking window; venue suggests three rounds of about 15 minutes heat and 3 minutes cold)
venues.schedule: Sat-Sun 10am-10pm, Mon-Fri 4pm-10pm. Book sessions in advance online. Waiver required.
venues.notes: Rustic club with two wood-burning saunas. Bring a swimsuit, towel and water bottle; sauna towels can be rented. Parking in the Emerald City lot. 4-credit pack $240, 8-credit pack $440; credits can be used at other PORTAL locations.

venues.name: Third Space & Co
venues.drop_in_price: $30 drop-in ($7 for a 7-day intro for first-timers)
venues.session_length: 1 hour sauna sessions; 2-hour social sessions (venue says time slots are suggestions)
venues.schedule: Mon-Fri 7-9am and 11am-10pm, Sat 10am-10pm, Sun 9am-9pm. Drop in anytime open or reserve a time online.
venues.notes: Converted warehouse bathhouse with four saunas (165-230°F), a lounge bar with non-alcoholic drinks, and indoor and outdoor areas. Heat source not stated. Bring a swimsuit, towel and non-glass water bottle; towels are limited. Arrive 10 minutes early for check-in. Free on-site parking.

venues.name: Berner Collective Sauna Club
venues.cold_plunge: Three cold plunges in the outdoor garden (included)
venues.notes: Two wood-fired saunas in an outdoor garden. Bring a swimsuit, water bottle and towel, and sit on your towel in the saunas. 4-credit pack $120, 8-credit pack $216 (credits also work for yoga classes).
